folds.heading: ## Full workflow reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B179)
folds.body:
All stages0–7, lessons and MAW-X1–X9 were read. Preserve fit before design at actual source/degree/consumer, original IDs and palettes, optional named research gaps, settled inputs and one publisher, and scoped verification before integration. Research/build lane tables are optional shapes under current authorization and budget, not dispatch requirements for this documentation reconciliation. A fixed three-lane pattern, advisor on every seam, old-save run or universal extra golden test would contradict the workflow’s own qualifications and AD36. Read declared validators and a meaningful failure case where the selected consumer needs them; preserve actual state/custody/quote/publish contracts.

Current AD51 permits designing a shared seam for several known world needs with its first consumer; a second different case validates/revises it under AR11. MAW-X3/X6 are proposals for reuse with concrete consumers, not an embargo until two implementations exist. A worktree does not automatically contain another checkout’s dirty bytes, and a branch or old idle chat does not release ownership. No worktree, skill mirror, importer, browser kit or integration helper was created. Existing yes-to-commit/push requirements remain specific actions, not a permission stop before saving this already authorized documentation.

MAW-X2’s export drift report would be an inventory lead, not proof every public/helper export requires a separate registry entry. X4 graded substitution and X8/X9 mapping proposals need their current actual callers and prior coverage before another implementation. The old potion findings and Haiku/wiki correction are historical source lessons, not current absence, model recommendation or source acquisition authority. Current rule owners supply source, browser, persistence and optional human review obligations; this document adds no new rulebook or runtime gate.

folds.heading: ## Reading-status reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B179)
folds.body:
The complete status owner, all October27–30 amendments, wave table, two Next-step lines and queue/extras sections were read. Later records supersede earlier snapshots: volume1 completion is reported after the old table’s waiting rows; the ten grade-C set-asides are reported done after the earlier next-step still asks to perform them. Keep the exact originals as chronology. Set-aside/lint grade repair does not mean every omitted fact was restored or source correctness proved.1768/1768 populated enrichment fields are completeness of fields, not1768 verified propositions: the15-step check retains11supported/3partial/1wrong. Likewise13of15supported pilot steps plus2partial is not perfect extraction.

Source-sized read-forward, census/people/rules/texture, scenes, enrichment, whole-book merge and actual native-readiness are different outputs. The note’s “fully read” claim records the campaign’s reported scope, not this reconciliation reading the underlying novel. Large prepared lists, acquired books, four-pass completion, rows ingested or script tags do not independently prove a complete semantic/scene audit. Medium versus high-effort trial results and metadata/lint grades retain exact samples. Unregistered chapter-finder failures are not automatically missing books, and frozen extras/chapter-number corrections retain their edition context. No sealed source truth is reproduced.

All quoted PIDs/process states, account percentages, dollar balances, month resets,70/85cap suggestions and projected59hours are dated observations or proposals. An old resume/kill command or request relayed in this record is not present permission to restart workers, stop someone’s process, spend API credit or alter current allowance. Current source/version coverage, quality and actual run authorization must be recovered only for a separately selected reading task. No private corpus, driver log, current process/meter/credit state or source edition was opened here, and no paid/subscription/local-model reading was launched.
